title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Salad
steps: Boil the rotini following its package directions; drain, rinse cold, and cool.
Season the thighs with barbecue rub. Grill over medium-high heat to the creator’s specified 175–185°F internal temperature; rest 5–10 minutes, then dice.
Combine the pasta, chicken, cooked bacon, cheese, half the onions, and some dressing. Toss, adding dressing to taste.
Refrigerate covered for at least 30 minutes.
Add the remaining onions and optional lettuce shortly before serving. Serve cold.
notes: Allow at least 30 minutes of chilling in addition to preparation and cooking.
